cutoff.meaning: Close of business on 31 July 2026, Eastern Daylight Time

negative_condition: Revenue from Torrent 800 headlamp sales in July 2026 is less than $8,000.
positive_condition: Revenue from Torrent 800 headlamp sales in July 2026 is at least $8,000.

proof.meaning: Total point-of-sale revenue from Torrent 800 headlamp sales for 1-31 July 2026, measured at close of business on 31 July.
proof.name: July 2026 Torrent 800 revenue

terminal_meaning: The question resolves to YES if Fernhaven Cycles' point-of-sale revenue from the Torrent 800 headlamp for 1-31 July 2026, measured at the close of business on 31 July, is at least $8,000; otherwise NO.
